data.name: Kayleen
data.gender_notes: Kayleen is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Irish name Ceilein, meaning 'little stranger'. The name may also have Greek and Latin origins, meaning 'pure' or 'clear'. The name Kayleen carries the meaning “Pure, clear, bright” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kayleen usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing purity and clarity of the soul.
data.etymology: Kayleen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clear, bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kayleen total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: קיילין
in_hebrew.meaning: קיילין משמעות שמה קורית לניקוי ולטהרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: קיילין הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה העברית והוא קשור לניקוי ולטהרה. השם קיילין נגזר מהמילה העברית 'קהל' שמשמעותה 'קורא לאספה' או 'נאסף'. השם מתאר את התכונות הרצויות של טהרה וקדושה.

in_greek.name: Καγληεν
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Καγληεν σημαίνει καθαρότητα και αγιότητα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Καγληεν είναι μια μορφή του ονόματος Kayleen που χρησιμοποιείται στην παράδοση της Ανατολικής Ορθοδοξίας. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'קהל' (qahal) που σημαίνει 'εκκλησία' ή 'συνάθροιση'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Καγληεν συμβολίζει την καθαρότητα και την αγιότητα.

in_latin.name: Kayleen
in_latin.meaning: Kayleen nomen significat purificationem et sanctimoniam
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kayleen in traditione Christiana significationem habet purificationis et sanctimoniam. Etymologia nominis Kayleen ex hebraeo 'qahal' (קהל) oritur, quod 'congregatio' vel 'ecclesia' significat. Nomen hoc virtutes desiderabiles puritatis et sanctitatis exprimit.

in_english.meaning: Kayleen means pure, clean, and holy in Christian tradition

The name has been adopted in various cultures, reflecting its universal themes of spiritual significance and moral integrity. Historically, the name Kayleen has been associated with virtues such as modesty, humility, and devotion.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Kayleen carries a sense of purity and clarity, symbolizing spiritual innocence and a connection to something divine. It also implies a sense of openness and welcoming to others, reflecting the Christian value of hospitality and love towards all strangers. This can serve as a reminder to live a compassionate and pure life, continually striving towards greater spiritual understanding and growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Kayleen is believed to have Celtic origins, derived from the word "Cailin," meaning slender or graceful one. In a spiritual sense, this name represents the delicate balance between the physical and spiritual realms, embodying the grace and beauty of the divine feminine. May a Kayleen inspire inner peace and strength throughout her life journey.
